annotations.title: AI digest of SEC 10-K, 10-Q and 8-K filings

description: AI-generated digest of one SEC EDGAR filing section: 10-K/10-Q risk factors (Item 1A) or MD&A, or 8-K item summaries with press-release exhibits. By accession, or ticker/CIK plus form (latest filing). Key points each carry a verbatim quote checked against the filing text and an EDGAR URL; optional new and removed risk factors versus the prior same-form filing. Generated by Anthropic Claude under a fixed Kit Rx prompt; not investment advice. Price: $0.02 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged. AI-generated answer; a call with no arguments returns the stored example answer without a model call.

accession.description: EDGAR accession number of a 10-K, 10-Q or 8-K (e.g. 0000320193-26-000026). Alternative to ticker/cik + form.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, 1 to 10 digits, instead of ticker.

compare_prior.description: 10-K/10-Q only: also read the prior filing of the same form and list new and removed risk factors (default false).

form.description: 10-K, 10-Q or 8-K: required with ticker or cik (latest filing of that form).

section.description: item_1a (Risk Factors), item_7 (MD&A; Part I Item 2 on a 10-Q) or 8k_items. Default: item_1a for 10-K, item_7 for 10-Q, 8k_items for 8-K.

ticker.description: Stock ticker (e.g. AAPL). With form, the latest filing of that form is digested.
